component.name: Ryzen Control
component.summary: Curve Optimizer, PBO limits and fans for Ryzen
Curve Optimizer, limiti PBO e ventole per Ryzen

description.p: Ryzen Master-style control for AMD Ryzen desktop processors on Linux (Ryzen 9000 verified, Ryzen 1000–7000 expected): per-core Curve Optimizer and Curve Shaper, PPT/TDC/EDC limits, boost frequency and maximum temperature, power profile and motherboard fans.

Controllo stile Ryzen Master per processori AMD Ryzen desktop su Linux (Ryzen 9000 verificati, Ryzen 1000–7000 attesi): Curve Optimizer e Curve Shaper per core, limiti PPT/TDC/EDC, frequenza di boost e temperatura massima, profilo energetico e ventole della scheda madre.
Default, Quiet, Performance, Eco, Auto and Boost modes with automatic calibration, profiles applied at boot and protection after a crash: the profile is not reapplied until the user decides.

Modalità Default, Quiet, Performance, Eco, Auto e Boost con calibrazione automatica, profili applicati all'avvio e protezione dopo un crash: il profilo non viene riapplicato finché non lo decide l'utente.
